world: 00 — Lab · S5 The Cipher Engine (rebuild, 2026-07-30). A procedural Enigma you can type into, presented twice: as a paper draft in the light register and as a lit brass machine in the dark one. The subject is a mechanism, so the whole design law is mechanical — quantised angles, independent tracks, nothing eased in lockstep.
policy: Lives on at /lab/s5-cipher-engine.html — the URL is preserved because it is the only inbound link we control and breaking it buys nothing. It stops being a copied file and becomes a Vite build entry: markup at site/lab/s5-cipher-engine.html, source at site/src/lab/cipher/, and site/public/lab/s5-cipher-engine.html is deleted so the copied and built outputs cannot collide in dist/lab/. s1, s2, s4 and the lab index stay static for now; this is the first study to move onto our stack, not a migration of all four. Dual register, both first-class: Proof (light) and Signal (dark), read from localStorage('hub-theme') in a pre-paint inline script so the lab-wide flip stays continuous, with S5 owning a toggle since the lab index has none yet. prefers-reduced-motion collapses every track to its end state and disables scroll-driven motion entirely; the page must be fully readable and fully interactive with zero animation.
typecasting: ONE family, used from 13px to colossal: Martian Mono (Evil Martians, SIL OFL-1.1, verified 2026-07-30). The upstream font carries two axes (wdth 75–112.5, wght 100–800) but only the weight-only variable build is published as woff2, so we self-host that — 23.5 KB latin at site/public/fonts/MartianMono-Variable.woff2, licence alongside. Hierarchy therefore comes from weight and scale alone; the width axis was a nice-to-have and is dropped rather than faked with transforms. The conviction: a machine that only knows 26 letters gets one face, and hierarchy comes from weight, width and scale rather than a second voice. Distinct from 04 Pulse, which also runs a single variable family, because that one is a geometric sans built by weight alone while this is a monospace built by weight AND width; distinct from 01 Noir, where mono exists only as a fixed 10px label role and never leads. Roles: display 700 at clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 6.5rem), lh 0.92, tracking −0.03em; body 400 at 15px, lh 1.55; labels 500 at 12px uppercase, tracking 0.16em. No italic anywhere — a machine does not lean.
downloads: HDRI: studio_small_03_1k.hdr — Poly Haven, CC0, 1.7 MB, DONE, on disk at site/public/hdri/. High contrast deliberately, so brass gets crisp speculars against a dark ground. Explicitly NOT studio_small_08, which is 02 Chrome's lighting signature; two worlds must not share an environment.

Type: Martian Mono weight-variable woff2 (SIL OFL-1.1) — DONE, self-hosted at site/public/fonts/MartianMono-Variable.woff2 (23.5 KB, latin) with licences/MartianMono-OFL.txt alongside, per the ASSETS.md self-host default.

Audio (optional, ships only if it reads as craft rather than gimmick): one key-click and one rotor-detent from Freesound, CC0 only, a few KB each, self-hosted per the heavy-media ruling — UI sound must be instant and cannot depend on a third party. Muted by default with an explicit affordance; never autoplay.

Everything else is generated: rotor letter rings, engraved plate, crinkle-paint bump, brass anisotropy, blueprint line art. No texture downloads — the sundial's procedural oak already proved this path in-repo.
sections: S1 COLD OPEN — the machine assembled, three-quarter view, one raking key. Colossal mono title over it. No scroll cue beyond a single tick mark; the page must look like an instrument at rest.

S2 ANATOMY — the case opens and the three rotors separate along the axle, each on its OWN track rate so they never arrive together. Labels arrive later still. This is the section that proves the motion law at a glance.

S3 THE WIRING — one letter's actual path drawn through the machine: keyboard → plugboard → rotor III → II → I → reflector B → back out. Traced live from the real cipher, not a decorative line, which is the whole reason the transform gets fixed.

S4 TYPE IT — the interactive floor. Physical keyboard and click both drive it; a key sinks, the right rotor steps one quantised notch, a lamp lights, the readout logs plain and cipher. Reciprocity is demonstrable: retyping the ciphertext at the same start position returns the plaintext, and the UI offers exactly that as a one-click proof.

S5 COLOPHON — what is made versus found, stated plainly: every rotor, key, lamp and cable is code; the only downloads are one CC0 HDRI and one OFL typeface. Draw-call and step-angle numbers printed as fact, because this world's whole voice is measurement.
centerpiece: A procedurally built Enigma, correct this time. THREE FIXES the current one needs, all verified as defects on 2026-07-30: (1) the brass nameplate is sealed inside the plugboard panel — measured overlap of 0.34 in y and 0.04 in z, with the panel's front face at z=1.693 against the plate's 1.640, so RENOCRYPT M-26 is invisible from every angle; the front fascia gets re-laid out so plate, plugboard and sockets each own their band. (2) The cipher is Enigma-flavoured but not Enigma: each rotor's ring offset is applied on entry and never removed on exit, so AAAAA gives DHLXO where a real Enigma I at AAA gives BDZGO, and the middle rotor's double-step is missing. Fix the transform to offset-in/offset-out and implement notch-driven stepping with the double-step anomaly; keep the reciprocity property, which the current one does at least satisfy. (3) The plugboard is geometry only — encrypt() never touches the panel and cables the case displays; wire it into the path at both ends so the cables mean something. Presentation: HDRI-lit brass and dark crinkle paint, one raking key light with a dirty-flagged shadow map, and the letter rings, engraving and paint tooth all generated at init.
assets2d: Proof register is not a fallback dressed up — it is a real second design: the same machine as a white-paper technical draft, hairline ink linework, engineering annotations, dimension arrows and the 13.846° step angle called out like a drawing callout. Signal register is the lit object in the dark. Both are drawn from the same geometry, so nothing can drift. Plus: the rotor letter ring (26 glyphs on one canvas strip, ONE texture shared by all three rotors), the engraved plate, and a graduated tick ring at 13.846° per mark, which is the pole's ~14.3° convergence made literal.
motion: The law, and the point of the rebuild. There is NO single scrubbed timeline — the current page has exactly one, four sequential camera keyframes on scrub 1.1, which is why it feels linear. Replace with native scroll normalised to v ∈ [0,5], read once per frame, then fed to independent tracks that each lerp toward their own target at their OWN rate, so nothing shares a curve: camera 0.045, machine yaw 0.075, rotor separation 0.11, label/lamp opacity 0.16, type reveal 0.09. Rates are deliberately non-harmonic — the drift between them IS the non-linearity, and it is the technique measured off obys (0.05 planes / 0.1 scroll / 0.15 cursor), applied per subsystem rather than per input. Discrete events quantise: every rotor rotation snaps to 360/26 = 13.846°, never a free angle, which is where the Any Given Moment dial pole lands. Two continuous background motions run OFF the scroll entirely, on wall-clock time, so the page is never fully still: a 19s light drift and a 31s idle yaw, desynced by design. Ease vocabulary for discrete UI: one snap curve, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.1, 1), 0.34s — mechanical, slightly overshooting, nothing like 02's single editorial bezier or 04's backOut pops.
fallback: Three rungs, and the bottom one is a design rather than an apology. Live WebGL → single still frame at dpr 1 for software renderers → the Proof blueprint in pure DOM/SVG, which is the light register and therefore already art-directed. This machine has no GPU, so rung 3 is what gets verified here and rung 1 gets verified by geometry math in node plus a real-GPU pass later. Hard guards, all currently absent from S5 and all required: webglcontextlost handler that hides the canvas without a white flash and repaints on restore, IntersectionObserver pause, visibilitychange pause, shadowMap.autoUpdate = false with explicit dirty flags, dpr capped at 1.75.
distinct: Canvas: near-black #08090b with BRASS and phosphor teal #62e6c8 — the teal is world 00's own accent, already quoted by the hub's --mint, and no other world has a warm-metal-plus-teal split. Closest adjacency is 01 Noir's charcoal + bone, adjudicated: Noir is a strict two-colour law where colour appears only as footage, while this world's identity IS metal, so the warm brass register separates them at a glance. Type: the only monospace-led world. Radius: 2px, unclaimed (01 is 4, 02 is 0, 03 has none, 04 is 44px pills). Ease: no page-wide ease at all — five track rates plus one snap curve. Scroll model: native scroll driving multi-rate independent tracks, distinct from 01's crane, 02's sticky runway, 03's hand-rolled virtual lerp and 04's zero-scroll FSM. Day/night: the only world where the two modes are two DIFFERENT REPRESENTATIONS of the subject — paper draft versus lit object — rather than one design with its values flipped. Centerpiece: the only mechanism in the lab that computes something real and that you operate with the keyboard.
